mostWorthwhile.text: Following insulin to the muscle was most worthwhile: it showed glucose becoming a store while insulin stayed outside as a message.

leastWorthwhile.text: The liver-release hormone was left unnamed, which made that part feel less complete even though its job was clear.

surprise.text: The liver's release signal eases as blood glucose rises, connecting the release to a change in the blood.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the last two pairings were the only available actions rather than choices I worked out independently.

continue.text: I would probably continue: comparing the two glucose routes was understandable, and I would be curious to see another connection between body systems.
